notes.text: Report a loss of NCCPA certification to the board within 10 days; the license then expires.

agreement.text: No written agreement is required at a licensed health care facility, a facility with credentialing and privileging, or a physician-owned practice. Outside those settings a PA with fewer than 4,000 hours of practice executes a written collaborative agreement with a North Dakota physician. A PA practicing outside those settings applies to the board for approval to practice independently.
